turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hello, Leander. I can help you find your print. Please send me the order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.

I am sorry, Leander, but I cannot look up orders by name. To find your order, I need both the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email the order was placed with. You can usually find the order number in your order confirmation email, and then I can check the status and tracking link for you once you share both details.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.

I am sorry, Leander, but I cannot share any order details, including the delivery address or shipping status, until I can verify that the order belongs to you. To do that, I need the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email the order was placed with. Once you send both, I can check the order for you.
